name: script_walk_to_mark
about: A scripted_sequence walks its NPC to the mark, plays, fires its outputs and lets it go (docs/specs/0003-scripted-sequence/spec.md § Witness data, recovered 2026-09-12). sm_vamparena's sVamp_entrance (m_fMoveTo 1, m_iszPlay pre_fight_bow, no idle or post-idle, no spawnflags, OnBeginSequence -> AsianVamp.SetRelationship 'player D_HT 5') and its target AsianVamp (npc_VAsianVampire, D_NU 0, 281 cm off), verbatim. BeginSequence 0x101a7390 -> PossessEntity (CCineNPC 0x101a7880): m_scriptState +0x5d70 = 4, DelayStart(1), ideal state NPC_STATE_SCRIPT; SelectSchedule 0x1028a380 case 4 -> SCHED_AISCRIPT 0x2e, TranslateSchedule 0x102cc080 / 0x102b12f0 -> SCHED_TROIKA_SCRIPTED_WALK 0xf2 (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_scripted_walk.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE, SET_TOLERANCE_DISTANCE 2, WALK_TO_TARGET, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, PLANT_ON_SCRIPT, FACE_SCRIPT, ENABLE_SCRIPT, WAIT_FOR_SCRIPT, PLAY_SCRIPT, PLAY_SCRIPT_POST_IDLE). OnBeginSequence fires from TASK_WAIT_FOR_SCRIPT's run arm when IsTimeToStart 0x101a7540 holds (on the mark, not at the input), then StartSequence(m_iszPlay); TASK_PLAY_SCRIPT waits m_bSequenceFinished -> SequenceDone 0x101a8460 -> Finish 0x101a8640 (no post-idle) and OnEndSequence fires unconditionally; CineCleanup 0x1027d170 sets the ideal state IDLE and FixScriptNPCSchedule 0x101a8840 clears the schedule, so the NPC selects again — here, hostile since OnBeginSequence, a combat program.
known_red: new: BeginSequence possesses nothing the kernel sees: no NPC_STATE_SCRIPT and no SCHED_TROIKA_SCRIPTED_WALK (the director's beat stands in, divergence 18, V3)
notes: The never on OnBeginSequence before 2.5 s pins retail's order (the output fires on the mark, not at the input; 0003 spec § 'The port today').
